card.name: Words just before death-toll counts
card.fires_on: Linking words and small connectors right before a mention of deaths or casualties, in accounts of wars, disasters and epidemics. The next word is likely deaths, casualties, lives or killed.

modes.label: Scale of war losses
modes.description: Words before casualty counts in descriptions of wars and rebellions.
modes.example: the famous Taiping Rebellion<< alone>> claimed tens of millions of lives.

modes.label: Disaster and epidemic tolls
modes.description: Connectors before death or injury counts after earthquakes, pandemics and attacks.
modes.example: There were no immediate reports<< of>> serious damage or injury.

modes.label: Number or cost phrasing
modes.description: Words after a figure or cost phrase where deaths or lives lost are expected next.
modes.example: the 1918 Spanish Flu that caused more than<< >>50 million deaths.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict words like deaths, casualties and fatalities, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on the words leading up to a body count in stories of wars and disasters.
